issues.quote: Trong tiếng Anh, trái cây là fruits.
issues.problem: As a general word for the food, 'fruit' is normally uncountable and singular. Teaching 'fruits' as the basic word is less natural. 'Fruits' means different kinds of fruit.
issues.fix: Huy: Trong tiếng Anh, trái cây là fruit. / Emma: Fruit. Fruit. / Mai: Fruit. Fruit.
